'''Jung-ju''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that possessed strong and fibrous [[Wood/Legends|wood]]. In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="CSWE" /> of [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> it was used in the design of [[reinforced fiber armor]], which implemented jung-ju tree fibers<ref name="CSWE" /> bound<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> with synthetic materials. The resultant [[Armor/Legends|body armor]] offered durability and flexibility that could compete with light armor produced out of metallic compounds.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jung-ju was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR" />
